summary: Nomura Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing that it will report its first quarter operating results for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, on July 29, 2026. The announcement includes the scheduled time for the release and a conference call webcast. No terms such as price per share, premium, or stake are provided, as this is a routine earnings notification. This filing does not involve any special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. It is a standard disclosure of an upcoming earnings release, which is an ordinary regulatory filing.
